{{Top}}
[[File:ColonelSignetRingOfTheEmpire.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Colonel wearing an Imperial [[Signet ring/Legends|signet ring]].]]

'''Colonel''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] used by [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-based forces (such as the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]) as well as certain [[Starfighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter Corps]]. Colonels ranked below [[General/Legends|generals]] and above [[Major/Legends|majors]], and were equivalent in rank to the naval rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]].

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

In the Imperial Army, the rank of colonel was divided into several grades. [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonels]], who could command a [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] of up to 4,000 soldiers, were the lowest rank. [[High Colonel/Legends|High Colonels]] were the highest rank of colonel, commanding a battlegroup of four to eight regiments. Although the rank of Colonel itself is not used within the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], the grades Lieutenant Colonel and High Colonel were used for those who commanded a regiment and [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of stormtroopers, respectively.

Colonel was also a rank used by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], for example Colonel [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]].
